A healthy vegetable dish achieved by steaming mushrooms in plant leaves.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Steamed Mushrooms by [[Cooking]] a [[Mushroom]] with any [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. To make their default version, Link can either use [[Hylian Shroom]]s and [[Hyrule Herb]]s, which offer no [[Added Effect]]s, or use [[Ingredient]]s that have contradicting Effects. Eating them will heal some of Link's [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. These healthy dishes are made by steaming Mushrooms in the leaves of plants. * '''Hearty Steamed Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Steamed Mushrooms}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A healthy vegetable dish achieved by steaming mushrooms in plant leaves.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Truffle]]s, [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s, [[Hearty Radish]]es, [[Big Hearty Radish]]es, or other hearty Ingredients. If eaten, they heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Energizing Steamed Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Steamed Mushrooms}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A healthy vegetable dish achieved by steaming mushrooms in plant leaves.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stamella Shroom]]s or other energizing Ingredients. They can be eaten to refill part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Enduring Steamed Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Steamed Mushrooms}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A healthy vegetable dish achieved by steaming mushrooms in plant leaves.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Shroom]]s or [[Endura Carrot]]s. Link's Stamina Wheel will be completely replenished and overfilled if he eats them. * '''Hasty Steamed Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Steamed Mushrooms}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A healthy vegetable dish achieved by steaming mushrooms in plant leaves.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Rushroom]]s, [[Swift Carrot]]s, [[Swift Violet]]s, or other hasty Ingredients. Consuming them will increase Link's movement speed. * '''Spicy Steamed Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Steamed Mushrooms}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A healthy vegetable dish achieved by steaming mushrooms in plant leaves.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sunshroom]]s, [[Warm Safflina]]s, or other spicy Ingredients. These mushrooms will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Electro Steamed Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Steamed Mushrooms}}
rants low-level electricity resistance.
A healthy vegetable dish achieved by steaming mushrooms in plant leaves.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Zapshroom]]s, [[Electric Safflina]]s, or other electric Ingredients. Link can eat them to gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Steamed Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Steamed Mushrooms}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A healthy vegetable dish achieved by steaming mushrooms in plant leaves.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Razorshroom]]s, [[Mighty Thistle]]s, or other mighty Ingredients. Eating them will provide a boost to Link's attack power. * '''Tough Steamed Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Steamed Mushrooms}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A healthy vegetable dish achieved by steaming mushrooms in plant leaves.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Ironshroom]]s, [[Armoranth]]s, or other tough Ingredients. Link's [[Defense]] will be increased when he eats them. * '''Sneaky Steamed Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Steamed Mushrooms}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A healthy vegetable dish achieved by steaming mushrooms in plant leaves.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Silent Shroom]]s, [[Blue Nightshade]]s, [[Silent Princess]]es, or other sneaky Ingredients. By eating them, Link will gain a boost to his [[Stealth]]. * '''Chilly Steamed Mushrooms''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Steamed Mushrooms}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A healthy vegetable dish achieved by steaming mushrooms in plant leaves.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Chillshroom]]s, [[Cool Safflina]]s, or other chilly Ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]] when he eats them. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Steamed Mushrooms have the same [[Recipe]] that they did in {{BotW}}, which involves [[Cooking]] a [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]] with any type of [[Mushroom]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Steamed Mushrooms is earned by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[Road to the Ancient Lab]]". It is made using two [[Hylian Shroom]]s and two [[Hyrule Herb]]s. Through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]", the number of each [[Ingredient]] required can be lowered to one. When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]]'s movement speed will increase by 10%. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Steamed Mushrooms Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Steamed Mushrooms icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Glazed Mushrooms * Mushroom }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
